#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long a, b, n;
    cin >> a >> b >> n;

    long long best_num = 0, best_den = 1;
    long long min_error = LLONG_MAX;
    long long best_denom = 1;

    for (long long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        long long tx = (i * a) / b;

        for (long long offset = -5; offset <= 5; offset++) {
            long long candidate = tx + offset;
            if (candidate < 0) continue;

            long long num = abs(b * candidate - a * i);
            long long den = i * b;

            if (num * best_denom < min_error * den) {
                min_error = num;
                best_num = candidate;
                best_den = i;
                best_denom = den;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << best_num << '/' << best_den;
    return 0;
}
